notes.subject: פנים
notes.rationale: cala 'udem' (pne) s taɛbranit yebna ɣef tigniwt deg uzzal — deg taqbaylit 'udem' yesɛa anamek-is amatu, ama n wemdan neɣ n tfekka.

notes.subject: הכשיר
notes.rationale: KJV/JPS: 'ad temmager lexlaṣ' d tazmert n trezmest; BSB: 'ad tesseḥkem tikci' — KJV ad tefk lexlaṣ, BSB ad tesseḥkem.

notes.subject: והוא לא פנים קלקל
notes.rationale: Anjadi n yiwen: ma yella win ur isnifed ara; win yerzan: ma yella win ur isnifed ara — anagraw aneggaru yettwahegga.

notes.subject: קלקל
notes.rationale: Tira n taɛbranit tettwalas isekkilen (qilqel) — tiɣmert-agi ur teddi ara deg tsuqilt.

translation: Ma yuɣal uzzal d awezɣan, ma ur isnifed ara ⟨udem-is⟩, ad isruḥu tazmert; maca tayriwt n lexlaṣ d taḥkma.
